title: CodeAssistant.Lib — feature-planning agent harness
summary: New net10.0 class library CodeAssistant.Lib depending only on LLMLib. A FeaturePlanner drives a planning agent through Discovery -> Alignment -> Design -> Refinement (loop until approved) in a single ILLMSession, using sandboxed read-only tools, an ask_user tool and a validated submit_plan tool. The approved plan is saved as markdown. A per-session tool restriction in GenericLibs.Net guarantees the planner is read-only. The TUI gets a 'Plan feature' mode.
findings: LLMLib 0.2.0 (latest on nuget.org): ILLMService (Create/Open/Get/DeleteSession), ILLMSession.AskStreamingAsync (text only), LLMSessionOptions { SystemMessage, Model, ReasoningEffort, Tools (AIFunction) }.

CopilotLib 0.5.0: CopilotOptions is a global singleton (EnableBuiltInTools, AvailableBuiltInTools, WorkingDirectory, ApproveAllPermissions, UserInputHandler); AvailableTools and OnPermissionRequest are built per session in CopilotService.GetSessionAsync.
With EnableBuiltInTools = false, Copilot runs in Empty mode: only web_fetch + caller custom tools; restrictive permission handler approves public URLs and caller custom tools only.
The TUI currently registers CopilotLib with built-in tools and ApproveAllPermissions = true, and already has markdown rendering (RenderToString) and a UserInputPrompt handler.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Sandboxed read-only tools
phases.goal: Give the agent codebase access that cannot modify anything or leave the repository root.

tasks.title: RepositorySandbox
tasks.description: Resolve paths with Path.GetFullPath against RepositoryRoot; reject paths outside root (root + separator, case-insensitive on Windows) and reparse points escaping root; skip excluded directories (bin, obj, .git, node_modules, configurable).

tasks.title: ReadOnlyRepositoryTools
tasks.description: AIFunctionFactory-based list_dir, read_file (line range, max lines/bytes, binary detection), grep_search (text/regex with matchTimeout, include glob, capped results), file_search (glob). Report each invocation through a callback.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Interaction tools, validator, renderer
phases.goal: Capture, validate and render the structured plan, and route questions to the host.

tasks.title: FeaturePlanValidator
tasks.description: Required title/summary/>=1 task; unique ids; DependsOn/ParallelWith/AcceptanceCriterionIds reference existing ids; every criterion has >=1 acceptance test; every task linked to >=1 criterion; Modify/Reference files exist in the sandbox. Returns actionable errors.

tasks.title: FeaturePlanMarkdownRenderer
tasks.description: Render TL;DR, Findings, Phases/Tasks with dependencies, Acceptance criteria with per-criterion test table, Relevant files, Decisions, Out of scope, Further considerations.

tasks.title: PlannerInteractionTools
tasks.description: Per-run ask_user (flush buffered assistant text, then IPlanningInteraction.AskUserAsync) and submit_plan(FeaturePlan) (validate; return errors so the model resubmits, or store and return 'accepted, wait for review').

phases.name: Phase 4 — Orchestrator & DI

relevantFiles.purpose: Plan feature mode, DI wiring, RenderToString reuse.

decisions: Library lives in this repo for now (ProjectReference from the TUI); may move to GenericLibs.Net later.
Depends on LLMLib only; no direct CopilotLib / Copilot SDK dependency.
Codebase access only via custom read-only tools sandboxed to RepositoryRoot; only the harness writes (the plan file).
Harness-controlled phases in one session; approval (or cancellation) is the only exit.
Plans must include tasks, acceptance criteria and at least one acceptance test per criterion.
GenericLibs.Net change limited to an additive per-session flag; no tool/reasoning events, structured-output API or ask-user abstraction in LLMLib.
outOfScope: An implementation agent that executes the plan.
furtherConsiderations: Also save the FeaturePlan as JSON next to the markdown so a future implementation agent can consume it without parsing markdown (recommended, cheap).
If the nested submit_plan schema causes issues in CopilotLib's AIFunction -> SDK conversion, fix it in CopilotLib rather than falling back to a planJson string parameter.
Default output under <root>/plans writes into the target repo; alternative is %LOCALAPPDATA%/CodeAssistant/plans/<repo-name>.
